pairs.subject: candidate-status-transparency
pairs.evidence: app/status/[token]/StatusClient.tsx:276 Every not_selected cause, including a closed or filled role (role_closed), shows the same body, 'The team has decided to move forward with other candidates' (messages/en.json:2132), so a requisition-level ending reads to the candidate as a considered comparative decline.

techniques.evidence: messages/en.json:2132 This one variant serves rejected, rematched and role_closed alike. Its comparative wording ('other candidates') asserts an evaluation that never happened when the role simply closed. It also says nothing about data retention or a person to contact.

messages/en.json:2124 The fixed 5-step spine, the terminal card in place of a half-lit trail, the 45s poll plus focus revalidation that stops at terminal, the last-updated stamp and relay-gated email copy are all realized. But under_review names a person ('A recruiter'), and this phase also covers the scoring, homework and custom columns and untouched queues. Step 2 says to write 'we'.

messages/en.json:2085 Failures are classified invalid vs retryable, only the initial load takes over the page (StatusClient.tsx:227) and decisions fail by omission. But the transient copy blames the candidate's connection for server faults and 429s. linkInvalid (en.json:2086) points to a 'most recent status link', yet the store has one permanent link per application with no reissue. The skeleton also has no timeout that turns it into the unavailable state.

app/status/[token]/StatusNextActionCard.tsx:77 The deadline for an action the candidate owes appears as an 'open until' commitment. No decision date is forecast anywhere on the page. There is no reply-by or posting-close date, and none was found that the organisation owns.

app/status/[token]/StatusClient.tsx:489 The question is asked on the candidate's own surface rather than by outbound email. The route decides whether to ask (terminal only), and a candidate who has answered sees a thanks state. Storage defects are judged on the API context.

app/status/[token]/StatusClient.tsx:34 The page renders only the closed projection type the API returns: status enum, title, company, updatedAt and capability booleans. It holds no internal id, and the next action is shown as kind and dates, never as a token.

pairs.subject: candidate-status-transparency
pairs.evidence: app/_lib/application-status.ts:84 The projection merges a requisition closure into the same not_selected value as a considered rejection, so no consumer can render cause-specific terminal copy. On the same path, an unmappable stage falls back to 'received' rather than a neutral in-progress state.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/application-status.ts:84 Cause and state are not separated. role_closed loses its identity at the boundary, so the requisition-ended variant cannot exist.

app/_lib/application-status.ts:87 The role map is total over StageRole and the route passes roleOf (route.ts:53). But roleOf returns null for an off-axis or retired column, and the code then falls back to the name map and finally to the entry bucket 'received'. That is the exact understating fallback the technique forbids: the unmappable case should get its own in-progress state.

app/api/status/[token]/nps/route.ts:76 These parts are realized: refusal outside the terminal window (409, line 69), one row per entry with replace (PK entry_id), the no-coercion parser and a sample floor of 10. But the response row stores no terminal outcome (the core.ts:2117 schema has no outcome column), so the figure cannot be split by hired, declined, withdrew or requisition-ended.

app/api/status/[token]/route.ts:77 The object is built field by field with jsonOk({...}): status enum, title, company, updatedAt and booleans. It carries no entry id, score or name. The pending action crosses as kind and dates, never as its capability token.

app/api/status/[token]/route.ts:81 An unknown token gets a coded 404, STATUS_LINK_INVALID, which makes no distinction between a wrong key and no entry. A store fault gets a coded 5xx with the cause kept off the wire. The tenant is resolved from the entry, not from a default (line 48).

app/api/status/[token]/route.ts:74 The only dates on the wire are recorded ones (updatedAt, sentAt) and the action deadline the organisation already enforces (expiresAt). No decision forecast is sent.
app/api/status/[token]/route.ts:56 Gives the timeline a last-updated moment derived on read. relayConfigured (line 60) supplies the channel-truth check the email-promise step consumes.
